_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and fill in values.
_billing_mode_help: 'subscription' = you pay a flat plan fee; tile labels reframe as API-equivalent value + ROI vs your subscription. 'api' = you pay per-request API rates and the dashboard shows real API spend.
_admin_api_key_help: Optional. Org-wide rollups (Settings -> Admin Keys at console.anthropic.com). Starts with sk-ant-admin01-. Most useful for accounts on pay-as-you-go API; subscriptions don't itemize.
